# dr_libs (third party)

`dr_mp3.h`: an MP3 decoder in one file, by David Reid, based on minimp3. Version 0.7.3, from
https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs at commit `5690d4671d7a` ("dr_mp3: Version 0.7.3"), unmodified.
License: public domain (Unlicense) or MIT No Attribution, the user's choice; see the end of the file.
Krate uses it for backing tracks (`shared/song/Audio.cpp`), under MIT-0.
